realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Ranger
primary.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
primary.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
primary.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

secondary.label: Storyteller
secondary.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
secondary.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

wheel.central_question: Should truth be carried urgently to those who need it, or found patiently by walking between worlds?

growth.label: Storyteller
growth.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
growth.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
growth.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

other_ally.label: Craftsman
other_ally.description: Believes excellence lives in the smallest details; discipline borders on devotion.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will refine this until it is right, no matter how long that takes.
other_ally.shadow_description: Keeps refining what was already good enough, and calls the compulsion discipline.

quarter.label: Technocrat
quarter.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
quarter.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
quarter.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

opposite.label: Messenger
opposite.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
opposite.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
opposite.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Historian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
